## Example 3.10 · Locate before calculating {#l2-middle-observations }

```{=html}
<div data-module="median" ></div>
```



::: {.takeaway}
The median need not be an observed value.
:::

::: notes
Use Locate the middle and then Locate the mode. The exact median is2.5 even though the only observed values are1,2,3. Keep the words position and value separate.
:::
